metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a C++20 command-line RS274/NGC G-code simulator in `output/`, buildable with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`.

- Entry point: `output/src/main.cpp`
- Core simulator: `output/src/sim.cpp`
- RS274 parsing + expressions: `output/src/rs274_parse.cpp`, `output/src/expression.cpp`
- Tool/parameter file support: `output/src/tool_table.cpp`, `output/src/parameters.cpp`
- JSON + trace writer: `output/src/json.cpp`, `output/src/trace.cpp`

Build:
- `cmake -B output/build -S output && cmake --build output/build`

Run:
- `./output/build/simulator --input program.ngc --output out.json`
- Optional trace: `--trace-output trace.json` plus exactly one of `--trace-time-step`, `--trace-distance-step`, `--trace-position-tolerance`
